About My Little Pet

My Little Pet is an independently developed virtual-pet game by Teja Priyan, based in India. Feed your companion, enjoy a cozy room and take a little break together.

Two editions, clearly explained

The published Free edition is available for Windows through our official itch.io page. Plus is an upcoming edition with more pets, movable furnishings, new toys and games, and a mobile room. Its planned one-time price is ₹99 INR.

Plus is not on sale. We do not accept payments or pre-orders here. Screenshots and animations show the product and development previews; they are not a playable Plus download.

A game for little breaks

Game coins are earned through play. They cannot be bought for cash, withdrawn, transferred as money or redeemed for prizes. There is no betting or gambling.

Get in touch

Developer and support: Teja Priyan · teja1616150@gmail.com. My Little Pet is the product name; this page does not claim company registration or payment-provider approval.
